chapter.heading: Sectarianism Is Carnal
chapter.v:
And I,
brethren, could not speak to you as to spiritual people but as to carnal, as to babes in Christ. [Ex. 13:21, 22; Ps.] [Ex. 14:21, 22,]

for you
are still carnal. For where there are envy, strife, and divisions among you, are you not carnal and behaving like mere men? [Ex. 16:4, 15, 35;]

For when
one says, “I am of Paul,” and another, “I am of Apollos,” are you not carnal?Watering, Working, Warning [1 Cor. 9:14;] [Ex. 17:5-7;]

Who then
is Paul, and who is Apollos, but ministers through whom you believed, as the Lord gave to each one? [Matt. 13:55] [Num. 14:29, 37;]

I planted,
Apollos watered, but God gave the increase. [Num. 11:4, 34;] [Acts 4:36;]

So then
neither he who plants is anything, nor he who waters, but God who gives the increase. [2 Cor. 10:4;] [Ex. 32:4; 1 Cor.]

Now he
who plants and he who waters are one, and each one will receive his own reward according to his own labor. [Rev. 2:14 j Num.]

For we
are God’s fellow workers; you are God’s field, you are God’s building. [Ex. 17:2,]

According to
the grace of God which was given to me, as a wise master builder I have laid the foundation, and another builds on it. But let each one take heed how he builds on it. [2 Tim. 2:6] [Ex. 16:2]

For no
other foundation can anyone lay than that which is laid, which is Jesus Christ. [Rom. 15:27;]

Now if
anyone builds on this foundation with gold, silver, precious stones, wood, hay, straw, [[Acts 18:3;] [Rom. 11:20]

each one’s
work will become clear; for the Day will declare it, because it will be revealed by fire; and the fire will test each one’s work, of what sort it is. [Lev. 6:16, 26;] [1 Cor. 1:9 u Ps.]

If anyone’s
work which he has built on it endures, he will receive a reward. [2 Cor. 6:17] [Matt. 10:10;]

If anyone’s
work is burned, he will suffer loss; but he himself will be saved, yet so as through fire. [Matt. 26:26-28; Mark 14:23; Luke 22:20;] [Acts 18:3;] [1 Cor. 8:1]

Do you
not know that you are the temple of God and that the Spirit of God dwells in you? [Deut. 32:38] [Acts 9:15;]

If anyone
defiles the temple of God, God will destroy him. For the temple of God is holy, which temple you are.Avoid Worldly Wisdom [John 4:36; 1 Cor. 3:8, 14; 9:18 y 1 Cor. 4:1; Gal. 2:7; Eph.]

Let no
one deceive himself. If anyone among you seems to be wise in this age, let him become a fool that he may become wise. [2 Cor. 11:12] [2 Cor. 11:10]

and again,
“The Lord knows the thoughts of the wise, that they are futile.” [Deut. 32:17;]

Therefore let
no one boast in men. For all things are yours: [2 Cor. 6:15,] [[Gal. 2:3; 3:2]]

whether Paul
or Apollos or Cephas, or the world or life or death, or things present or things to come—all are yours. [Deut. 32:21] [Rom. 14:1;]

And you
are Christ’s, and Christ is God’s. [1 Cor. 6:12]
